task_title: Quickstart plugin row reworded hook-scoped: enforcement lives on the engine path
task_criteria: docs/quickstart.md is the changed file: its Hermes-plugin row no longer asserts 'no code path enforces, rejects, or size-limits a command'; the reworded row scopes 'observability-only' to the Hermes hooks and attributes command size / byte-budget enforcement to the engine path (HERMES_TERMINAL_JAIL_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES, enforced at intercept()), consistent with README.md's env-var table ('Read and enforced by the plugin') and quickstart section 3a2. Proof: scripts/docs-check.py exits 0 and rg -n 'byte budget reserved' README.md docs/ returns zero matches on the changed tree.

items.detail: Change landed in commit 65c50b96 ('fix(docs): quickstart plugin row scoped to hooks — byte budget enforced on the engine path'), docs/quickstart.md | 2 +- , 1 file changed. New row at docs/quickstart.md:23 scopes the hook surface ('Hook-level command wrapping and limiting: NOT IMPLEMENTED… The Hermes hooks observe… cannot wrap or size-limit a command') and attributes engine-path enforcement ('Command size IS enforced on the engine path: HERMES_TERMINAL_JAIL_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES… enforced at intercept()'). Old assertion 'no code path enforces' exists only at 65c50b96~1:rg across the tree (excl .gitreins/.git) exit=1, zero matches. Consistency: README.md:515 env-var row says 'Read and enforced by the plugin… enforced at intercept()'; quickstart §3a2 (docs/quickstart.md:259-308) documents the engine producing the wrap via the JSON bridge. Proof gates run fresh: python3 scripts/docs-check.py -> exit_code 0, 'docs-check: overall PASS'; rg -n 'byte budget reserved' README.md docs/ -> exit=1 (zero matches). Tests: tests/test_quickstart_doc.py fresh run '8 passed in 0.02s'; full suite per prior stage 2227 passed, 15 skipped.

items.criterion: Derived: the reworded enforcement claim is substantively true — HERMES_TERMINAL_JAIL_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES is actually read and enforced at intercept() in the shipped code, so the row documents real behavior
items.detail: plugin/terminal_jail/plugin.py defines _MAX_COMMAND_BYTES_ENV_VAR='HERMES_TERMINAL_JAIL_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES' with default 131072 and _check_byte_budget(); the refusal string lives inside intercept() at plugin/terminal_jail/interruptor/__init__.py:123 ('Auto-sandbox skipped: wrapped command exceeds the configured byte budget'). Live probe on this tree: env TERMINAL_JAIL_INTERRUPTOR_RULES_DIR/USER_RULES_DIR=/tmp/tj-empty-rules and HERMES_TERMINAL_JAIL_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES=10, printf '{"command": "make test"}' | python3 plugin/terminal_jail/interruptor_bridge.py -> stderr 'wrapped command exceeds the configured byte budget (134 bytes); unwrapping' and verdict reason 'Auto-sandbox skipped: wrapped command exceeds the configured byte budget', rc=0 — exactly matching the row's claim.
